title: Eastern Libya's Army Chief of Staff Arrives in Türkiye After Call With Ankara
excerpt: A phone call on Wednesday, a visit on Thursday: Ankara and the Libyan National Army have held two senior military contacts in two days.
rank_math_title: Eastern Libya's army chief of staff in Türkiye | Defence MENA
rank_math_description: The Libyan National Army's chief of staff is in Türkiye a day after Ankara's top general spoke by phone with the LNA's deputy commander-in-chief.
